## Checks / 检查

- [ ] I checked recent issues and commits for duplicate work.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, local env files, generated build output, or private data.
- [ ] I updated tests or explained why tests are not needed.
- [ ] I updated docs when setup, deployment, security, or API behavior changed.

- [ ] 我已检查近期 issue 和提交，避免重复工作。
- [ ] 我没有提交密钥、本地环境文件、构建产物或私密数据。
- [ ] 我已更新测试，或说明无需测试的原因。
- [ ] 设置、部署、安全或 API 行为变化时，我已更新文档。
